pick.name: Vanta
pick.what: Market-leading compliance automation: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, trust center
pick.why: Largest integration set and auditor network; Essentials/Plus/Professional/Enterprise tiers
pick.free_limits: No free tier; price by demo (secondary sources suggest USD 10k+/yr)

best_free.name: Probo
best_free.what: Open-source compliance platform: controls, risks, vendors, policies, public compliance page
best_free.why: MIT licence, very active, covers SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR/HIPAA/ISO 42001
best_free.free_limits: Self-host free; managed offering exists (price unchecked)

alts.name: Drata
alts.why: Strong rival to Vanta; owns SafeBase trust centre; 25 trust-centre approved domains free

alts.name: Comp AI Community Edition
alts.what: Open-source SOC 2/ISO automation with quote-based managed cloud
alts.why: Cheaper managed path to a first audit for small teams; OSS core
alts.free_limits: CE self-host free; managed pricing by 20-minute call

decision: Do not buy SOC 2 tooling before a deal requires it. Write policies and collect evidence in an OSS tool like Probo now so a Type I takes weeks. When a buyer insists, Vanta or Drata (plus a separate auditor) give the smoothest path; Sprinto or Comp AI are cheaper options to quote.
details: Pick changed from Probo (free) to Vanta (best overall); Probo moved to best_free. Prices are secondary sources; get quotes.

verify.note: Vanta demo-priced; market default. Prices secondary.
